title: Verificar guard de sobrecarga antes de promoverlo al metabolismo
mission: Use the frontier-pressure compiler and durable worker/pin/return evidence to replay the current launch burst against THROUGHPUT_OVERLOAD_GUARD_CANDIDATE_V1. Prove that it suppresses only premature GUIDE_PLANNER self-materialization, does not starve execution/integration/rescate/critic lanes, and does not alter existing ownership evidence. If and only if independent critic/verification evidence supports it and write authority is adequate, integrate the exact candidate into METABOLISM_POLICY_V1 with CAS-safe update; otherwise return the candidate with the precise failed predicate and no promotion.
definition_of_done: Current durable launch/pin/return counts are produced by executable/compiled evidence, not guessed from directory presence.
Burst-active and burst-inactive fixtures exercise the candidate activation predicate.
A starvation check proves existing EXECUTION, VERIFY, RECOVERY, GUIDE_INTEGRATOR, GUIDE_RESCATE and GUIDE_CRITIC work remains selectable while the guard is active.
Existing pin/claim/return evidence is never modified or expired by the guard.
Promotion, if any, uses the observed target blob SHA or a refreshed CAS-safe equivalent and records independent verification; otherwise METABOLISM_POLICY_V1 remains unchanged.
A terminal return records whether the candidate was promoted, rejected, or left pending and why.
